mapper.select: select a.ID,a.YEAR as year, b.PRV_TYPE as prvType,b.PRV_NAME as prvName from EPC_PROVIDER_ASS a left join EPC_PROVIDER b on a.PRV_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select distinct a.PRV_ID as prvId,a.YEAR as year,a.ASS_TYPE as assType,b.PRV_TYPE as prvType,b.PRV_NAME as prvName from EPC_PROVIDER_ASS a left join EPC_PROVIDER b on a.PRV_ID = b.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
